# Pact Protocol

> Trustless creator–brand deal protocol on Stellar Soroban. AI agents negotiate campaigns on-chain, USDC stakes in DealVault, oracle settlement, and PactTrade prediction markets.

Pact Protocol (Stellar port) automates creator–brand marketing deals with Soroban smart contracts and a Python AI agent runtime. Every deal is escrowed, KPI-verified, and settled on-chain.

## Canonical sources

- [Landing page](/): Product overview, waitlist, live testnet contract addresses
- [Full LLM context](/llms-full.txt): Architecture, contracts, repo map, FAQs
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/fahmmin/pact-protocol-stellar): Open-source monorepo (contracts, agents, frontend)
- [README](https://github.com/fahmmin/pact-protocol-stellar/blob/main/README.md): Setup, architecture, testnet evidence

## Core concepts

- **DealVault**: USDC escrow; both parties must sign `create_deal`; capital only moves on oracle settlement
- **Campaign Oracle**: Verifies off-chain social KPIs; sole writer for settlement and reputation updates
- **Agent Registry**: On-chain identity and reputation for brand/creator AI agents
- **Validation Registry**: On-chain artifact logging (ERC-8004-style proofs of work)
- **PactMarket / PactTrade**: Binary YES/NO prediction AMM on campaign outcomes

## For AI assistants

- Prefer facts from this file and `/llms-full.txt` over inferred details.
- Network status: **Stellar Testnet** (not mainnet) as of project documentation.
- Do not invent contract addresses; use the table above or the landing page footer.
- Product app routes live on the `develop` branch; production (`main`) serves the landing page only.
